title: ADHD/CD-NET: automated EEG-based characterization of ADHD and CD using explainable deep neural network technique.
summary: The primary source Methods/Results confirm the represented result: A CNN on EEG wavelet correlation matrices distinguishes ADHD, ADHD+CD and CD, evaluated by 10-fold cross-validation on a private set and an external public dataset; a clinically specific retrospective assessment with Grad-CAM explanations.
